sub_palette: latinate (classical) backbone + sinitic (east_asian) substrate (cross-family deep fusion, Roman-leaning)

blend.backbone: classical (latinate / Roman register: the -us/-a/-or endings, penultimate stress, c=k, the legion-road-codex civic order, the gens-binomial name; the law-and-Mandate imperial register)
blend.overlay: east_asian (sinitic: the walled cheng-cities and the silk-road, the celestial bureaucracy and the magistracy, the monosyllabic river/silk/material roots, the surname-first lineage, -di/-jun/-wang celestial titles)
blend.lean: Roman-heavy - a Latinate law-and-Mandate empire of legions, roads and the codex grown around a Sinitic substrate of walled silk-cities and a celestial magistracy: the Roman civic-legal register rules, the Sinitic bureaucracy and silk-trade endure and serve within.

_note: NEW cross-family hybrid under the base/hybrid model. BASE_06 Agrippan (Roman/Latinate) x BASE_09 Jinxian (Sinitic). CIV/CLAN DECIDED by inheritance: both parents Civilized, and any Civ parent -> Civ, so Serica is Civilized (feudal). Concept: a single emergent civilization - the silk-land Serica, a great law-giving empire that weds the Roman legion, road and codex to the Chinese walled-city, bureaucracy and Mandate of Heaven. Backbone = Latinate/Roman (the imperial law-and-Mandate register, the legions, the gens-binomial, the -us/-a endings); overlay/substrate = Sinitic (the walled cheng-cities, the silk-road, the celestial magistracy, the monosyllabic river/silk/material roots). Not backbone+overlay slash-glossing: the lexicon is a single FUSED tongue derived by sound-law (see phonology.fusion_rules), and titles and deity-names are genuinely fused forms (Latin -us/-a/-or + Sinitic monosyllabic roots). Common-word lexicon and rank titles fuse the real Latin/Chinese registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are fused morphs of the Agrippan canon (Latin reflexes primary, Sinitic variants secondary), never real Roman/Chinese gods. Ruler/domain DISPLAY titles are English (or an approved foreign term - empire shows 'Imperator'); the conlang titles are moved to ruler_native/domain_native for NPC dialogue. [REWORKED 2026-06-28 to base/hybrid model: csv_id HYB_43; all-three alignment; English display titles + native; deep-fusion lexicon + fusion_rules.]

phonology.palette: Latinate (Roman) backbone - vowel-rich a e i o u, liquids l/r, sibilant s, stops p t c(=k) b d g, f/v, the -us/-a/-um/-or office-endings, penultimate stress, onset clusters st/tr/pr/cl/sp, geminates ll/ss/tt - meeting a Sinitic substrate: tight monosyllabic roots, no clusters, initials incl. zh/ch/sh/x/q/j, finals only -n/-ng, -di/-jun/-wang celestial titles. Per the fusion: Latin syllable-shape and stress dominate; Sinitic roots are wrapped to one Latinate skin, keeping a few signature Sinitic finals (-an/-eng/-ong) and sibilants. Theophoric on the Latin reflexes (Tulin-, Orlan-) with Sinitic celestial variants (Tuli-di, Orla-jun).
phonology.phonotactics: CV / CVC; Latin clusters (st, tr, pr, cl, sp) and vowel-final endings meeting Sinitic tight monosyllables (no Sinitic clusters); Sinitic finals -n/-ng tolerated; fused endings -us/-a/-or wrapped onto a Sinitic root, or a Sinitic monosyllable closing a Latin stem; penultimate stress throughout.

sound_changes: Sinitic exotic initials -> Latinate inventory where harsh: zh>j, q>c, x>s before back vowels (x kept before front), retroflex sh>s (a few signature sh/zh kept on silk/river roots); no tone marking

Sinitic roots take a Latin office/quality ending where they stand alone: bare monosyllable + -us/-a/-or/-um (river *jiang -> flu- stem + -jiang fused; salt yan -> sal- + -yan); roots stay open or close on -n/-ng
Latin penultimate stress and syllable-shape imposed on every word; Latin clusters (st, tr, pr, cl, sp) permitted, Sinitic clusters forbidden (none exist)
retain Latin -us/-a/-um/-or and the Sinitic finals -an/-eng/-ong/-iao; very short Latin roots may close on a Sinitic monosyllable instead of a vowel
fusion_rules.source_tilt: river/water, silk/trade-goods, bureaucratic/civic-office and raw-material/staple words drawn from SINITIC roots (the substrate works the silk-land, the rivers and the magistracy: jiang, si, cha, yu, shi); rule/sovereignty, kin-line, law/oath, land/territory, quality and war words drawn from LATIN roots (the ruling civic-legal register: rex, gens, lex, ager, magnus, ferrum); each chosen root then filtered through the one Latinate phonology so the split is invisible at the surface - it all sounds like one tongue.

lexicon._note: Single fused tongue derived via phonology.fusion_rules (gdd-hybrid-conlang-fusion.md): Sinitic river/silk/material/bureaucratic roots + Latin rule/kin/law/land/quality roots, all run through one Latinate-shaped sound-law (penultimate stress, -us/-a/-or wraps, Sinitic finals tolerated); portmanteaus mark the blended silk-and-Mandate institutions and the imperial bloodline. No slash-pairs - one word per concept.

morphology.patronymic_form: the gens-xing (a fused clan-surname, family-first) + a given praenomen-ming; a courtesy-name for officials; generation-names within the lineage.
morphology.compounding_rule: [surname-xing] + [given]; toponyms quality + type: Aur-cheng (golden-city), Via-Serica (the silk-road), Mon-shan (the mountain).

title_ladder.government: feudal (a law-and-Mandate empire: the Imperator (native Imperdi) holds the Mandate over the peerage and a vast literate magistracy; the legions and the codex sustain the order)
title_ladder._tiers_note: DISPLAY ruler/domain titles are English, except the empire tier which shows the approved foreign term 'Imperator' (the commonly-known Roman imperial title). The *_native forms are the fused Latin-Sinitic conlang titles for NPC dialogue: Castelnan (castellan-baron, castellanus+nan); Limitudu (march-commander, limitanus+dudu); Combo (count, comes+bo); Duxou (duke-marquis, dux+hou); Princong (prince-duke, princeps+gong); Rexwang (king, rex+wang); Imperdi (emperor holding the Mandate, imperator+huangdi) over the Imperdium. The legions (legio) and the celestial magistracy serve the throne. (Rank titles fuse the real Latin/Chinese register, allowed.)
title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler' - here the empire tier shows 'Imperator'). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: the gens-xing surname first, then a given praenomen-ming; a courtesy-name (zi) for adults; the magistracy and legions add an office-title.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the magistracy and learned take a courtesy-name and sobriquet; commoners surname + given.
people_name_convention.theophoric: names invoke virtue and the celestial powers' epithets; e.g. Tian-en (heaven's grace), a temple-name honoring Tulin-di.

religion._note: Deity-names are fused morphs of the Agrippan canon (Latin reflexes primary, Sinitic variants secondary), never real Roman/Chinese gods. All-three alignment: Serica's stance follows its CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment). A Celestial Bureaucracy under the Mandate of Heaven, fused with the Roman law-cult: the One (Aiterneng) is Highest Heaven and source of the Mandate; the Lawful powers the celestial magistracy that gave the law; the templ-miao temple and the law-curia keep the rite.
religion.the_one: Aiterneng (< Aeternus; fused Latin Aeternus / Sinitic Aiteng) - Highest Heaven, the source of the Mandate and the law; revered above all when Lawful, served-not-petitioned when Neutral

Tulrius.gloss: sun and judgment, lord of the law-stele; Lawful power

Numeno.gloss: the scribe-wisdom, keeper of the codex; Lawful power

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: revere the One (Aiterneng) and the Lawful powers (Tulin, Orlanus, Numengus, Gaidunus), demonize the Chaotic demon-marshals (Maraluo, Wucidus, Lusanus)
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: all powers ambivalent; foreground the deified ancestors (the ancestral hall and the Divi) and the local earth-and-grain powers
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: venerate the Chaotic demon-marshals of the canon (Maraluo, Wucidus, Lusanus) and name the Lawful powers - and Aiterneng, the One - as the tyrant-throne of Heaven to be defied

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers are the demon-marshals outside the celestial order, each with an epithet: Maraxus -> Maraluo the War-Fire Marshal; Vacidus -> Wucidus the Devourer; Lusanto -> Lusanus the Coin-Serpent.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Templ-miao (temple) of [power]: 'the Templ-miao of Tulin'; the law-curia keeps its codex-stele.
religion.saints_pattern: deified law-givers and worthy officials enrolled in the celestial register; 'Divus [name]' / 'the Lord [name]', honored at the ancestral hall and the miao.

holy_symbol_motifs.Tulin: a winged sun-disc above the law-stele and the scales
holy_symbol_motifs.Numengus: stylus and codex above the seal of office

banks_patterns.ships: grand-canal junks and war-galleys: 'the Aquila', 'the Jade Dragon', 'the Mandate of Heaven'
banks_patterns.military_units: the Legio of [number/god] / the [color] Banner: 'the Legio of Orlanus', 'the Azure Banner'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: buried law-cities and tomb-mounds along the silk-road: 'the Tomb of [name]', 'the Ruined Cheng of [warlord]'
